using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;
using Garnet.common;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public unsafe class ReplicationManagerTests
    {
        // We will create a minimal subclass to expose ProcessPrimaryStream for testing
        // and inject a mock logger to verify LogWarning call on exception.
        private class TestReplicationManager : ReplicationManager
        {
            public TestReplicationManager(ILogger logger)
            {
                this.logger = logger;
                // Setup minimal required state to allow ProcessPrimaryStream to run and throw
                // We will cause an exception by setting clusterProvider to null or other means
            }

            public new void ProcessPrimaryStream(byte* record, int recordLength, long previousAddress, long currentAddress, long nextAddress)
            {
                base.ProcessPrimaryStream(record, recordLength, previousAddress, currentAddress, nextAddress);
            }
        }

        [Fact]
        public void ProcessPrimaryStream_LogsWarningOnException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var replicationManager = new TestReplicationManager(loggerMock.Object);

            // We will cause an exception inside ProcessPrimaryStream by setting clusterProvider to null
            // but clusterProvider is private, so we cannot do that directly.
            // Instead, we will pass invalid parameters that cause an exception in the method.

            // Prepare dummy record pointer
            byte[] dummyData = new byte[1];
            fixed (byte* p = dummyData)
            {
                // Act & Assert
                var ex = Assert.Throws<GarnetException>(() =>
                    replicationManager.ProcessPrimaryStream(p, 1, 0, 0, 0)
                );

                // Verify that logger.LogWarning was called with the exception and the expected message
                loggerMock.Verify(
                    x => x.Log(
                        LogLevel.Warning,
                        It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                        It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("An exception occurred at ReplicationManager.ProcessPrimaryStream")),
                        It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                        It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                    Times.Once);
            }
        }
    }
}
